newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-RONALD DE BOER VOTED DUTCH PLAYER OF YEAR.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-RONALD DE BOER VOTED DUTCH PLAYER OF YEAR.

text.p: Ajax Amsterdam midfielder Ronald de Boer has been voted Dutch Player of the Year by his fellow professionals.
De Boer, who also won the award in 1994, received the accolade on Monday evening.
Feyenoord captain Ronald Koeman, winner in 1987 and 1988, was second and last year's winner, PSV Eindhoven's Belgian striker Luc Nilis, third.
Heerenveen's Danish striker John Dahl Tomasson, currently the first division's leading marksman with 16 goals, was voted most promising newcomer.
Edwin van der Sar of Ajax was voted best goalkeeper for the third consecutive year, while Louis van Gaal, the Ajax team chief, picked up the award for best trainer.
